test_TinyShakespeareTest: test the TinyShakespeareTest class that validates the tiny_shakespeare dataset builder with train, validation, and test splits
test_Builder: test the Builder class from tiny_shakespeare_dataset_builder that generates train, validation, and test splits from Shakespeare text data
test__info: test the _info method that returns dataset features with a text field and supervised keys set to None
test__split_generators: test the _split_generators method that downloads Shakespeare text and splits it into 90/5/5 train/validation/test splits
test__generate_examples: test the _generate_examples method that yields examples with text features for each split
